purpose: Current hard-bound gate for whether any compatible high-acceptance verifier/draft path can be implemented next toward the 10 tok/s strict-cold vendor DeepSeek objective.

current_accepted_sota.strict_ram_rule: 16GB cgroup including file page cache, MemorySwapMax=0, no swap/OOM

promotion_gate.ttft_ms: <= 33617.688744 for accepted SOTA; TTFT-regressed runs may only be recorded as rejected diagnostics
promotion_gate.correctness: fixed-text top1 gate first, then France generated answer must be semantically correct and coherent
promotion_gate.reproducibility: record full env/CLI/run paths/metrics and immediately push source plus artifacts to ssd/vendor/deepseek-token-rate-16gb; clean pushed-source reproduction required before accepting a new SOTA

notes: No local official DSpark safetensors checkpoint is present under /root/lfz/models.
No local antirez DeepSeek-V4-Flash-MTP-Q4K-Q8_0-F32.gguf file is present.
Only the accepted target DeepSeek GGUF is locally available for the vendor strict-cold path.

official_dspark_huggingface_api.observed_weight_format: 48 safetensors shards plus Hugging Face config/tokenizer and custom inference code

why_generic_speculative_is_not_a_solutio: The generic llama-speculative path requires a standalone draft model with compatible vocab. The antirez file is a supplementary one-layer MTP artifact, not a standalone draft model.
The official DSpark artifact is safetensors/custom inference code, not a GGUF accepted by the current vendor runner.
The existing lookup/ngram style speculation has historical DeepSeek4 failures or insufficient acceptance and does not remove the CPU up/down fallback bottleneck.
grep_findings: src/llama-model.cpp reads nextn_predict_layers for several architectures and can skip/preserve some NextN tensors.
src/llama-model.cpp contains comments that NextN/MTP tensors are preserved but unused.
No source hit was found for deepseek4_mtp_support, deepseek4.mtp_layer_count, or mtp.0 tensor runtime handling under src.

rate_bound.formula: tok_s = 4.4 * (A + 1) / (C_verify + C_draft), where A is average accepted draft tokens and C_verify + C_draft is measured in units of one current target-token pass.

forced_batch_target_verifier_diagnostic.conclusion: current vendor fixed-text path shows no measurable sublinear multi-token target evaluation

mtp_union_source_amortization_bound.conclusion: W=5/W=6 do not reach 10 even under unrealistic perfect non-MoE batching; W=8 is theoretical-only with no compatible verifier/runtime proof

deepseek4_mtp_n2_verifier_cost_bound.conclusion: exact N=2 cannot reach 10 because target verify plus draft must be <= 300 ms while CPU up/down fallback alone is about 139.9 ms/token

memory_vram_ttft_bound.mmap_without_touch_decision: not_sufficient; touched MTP pages still count against the same 16GB cgroup and will either displace target page cache or exceed the strict page-cache budget
memory_vram_ttft_bound.odirect_stream_decision: not_source_ready; may avoid page cache but adds per-use IO/latency and needs a loader/runtime design plus performance proof
memory_vram_ttft_bound.vram_mtp_residency_decision: unproven; placing MTP tensors/workspaces on GPU risks reducing the accepted gate cache and must first account for lost hit rate, workspace, and fallback behavior

correctness_requirements_before_any_benc.fixed_text_top1: Run llama-results fixed-text target-only vs verifier/draft path under strict 16GB/no-swap cgroup. Any top1 mismatch rejects the path before performance.
correctness_requirements_before_any_benc.generated_france_prompt: Please introduce France in a short paragraph. Output must remain semantically correct and coherent.
small_prompt_set: Please introduce France in a short paragraph.
Write a short Python function for Fibonacci.
Introduce Japan in a short paragraph.
Summarize climate change in one paragraph.
correctness_requirements_before_any_benc.state_correctness: KV/cache commit and rollback must preserve the exact target greedy stream; speculative/draft tokens cannot contaminate accepted state.

rollback_rules: Reject and revert runtime changes if memory.peak exceeds 16000000000 bytes, swap occurs, or memory.events oom/oom_kill is nonzero.
Reject as accepted SOTA if TTFT exceeds 33617.688744 ms; commit only as rejected diagnostic if useful.
Reject before performance if fixed-text top1 differs from target-only at any checked position.
Reject before performance if France output is semantically wrong or incoherent.
Reject before performance if default accepted path changes without the explicit verifier/draft mode enabled.
Reject if target verification is effectively linear in draft length or if preserving the accepted gate cache is impossible.

decision.reason: The only concrete external artifacts are official DSpark safetensors/custom code and antirez supplementary one-layer MTP GGUF. Neither is locally present or loadable by current vendor source. Existing hard bounds show official block-size 5 is below 10 under source-union math, exact N=2 is closed, and current fixed-text batch evaluation shows no target verifier batching speedup. Additional MTP bytes also fail the current full-preload TTFT slack and are unproven under the strict 16GB page-cache budget.
next_allowed_work: Reopen verifier/draft only if a concrete compatible artifact proves A>=7, or A>=5 with measured sublinear target verification, plus RAM/VRAM/TTFT/correctness accounting.

Otherwise move to a new non-native representation or algorithm artifact that proves >5.33x effective payload reduction, fixed-text top1 correctness, France correctness, and decode overhead below the top4096 1008.842 ms slack before any code.
